name: Sins Of The Flesh
overview: The Scriptures reveal that the sins of the flesh arise from a carnal mind that is hostile to God and cannot submit to His law, leading to death if one lives according to the flesh. These works of the flesh include adultery, fornication, uncleanness, and lasciviousness, behaviors that are incompatible with a life pleasing to God. However, those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts, and through the Spirit, they are called to mortify the deeds of the body and walk honestly, avoiding rioting, drunkenness, and other sinful practices. This transformation is rooted in the new life given by God, who quickens those once dead in trespasses and sins.
